recommendations.recommendation: Update connection strings in appsettings.json to PostgreSQL format
recommendations.rationale: Connection string format differs between SQL Server and PostgreSQL (e.g., Server → Host, Integrated Security → appropriate PostgreSQL auth)

recommendations.recommendation: Consider using Npgsql parameter placeholders ($1, $2) instead of @ParameterName
recommendations.rationale: While Npgsql supports SQL Server parameter format, native PostgreSQL format may offer better performance
